en-UK.name: Web Search
en-UK.description: Lets AI characters search the web through the configured search source.
en-UK.description_markdown:
The **Web Search** plugin gives AI characters a `<web-search>` tool backed by the user's preferred search service source.

Some code is derived from [GentianAphrodite](https://github.com/steve02081504/GentianAphrodite).
en-UK.author: steve02081504

zh-CN.name: 网络搜索
zh-CN.description: 通过已配置的搜索服务源为 AI 角色提供网络搜索能力
zh-CN.description_markdown:
**网络搜索**插件为 AI 角色提供 `<web-search>` 工具，并使用用户首选的搜索服务源。

部分代码来自[龙胆](https://github.com/steve02081504/GentianAphrodite)。
zh-CN.author: steve02081504
